name: p3stack
description: The Pi edition of Cursor's pstack: router mode, playbooks, principles and routed skills, generated from the vendored upstream and translated for Pi in a terminal and under T3 Code.

scripts.sync: git -C ../.. submodule update --init packages/p3stack/vendor/pstack packages/p3stack/vendor/matt-pocock packages/p3stack/vendor/agent-skills packages/p3stack/vendor/superpowers && node generator/generate.mjs
scripts.check: node generator/generate.mjs --check && node generator/lint-hosts.mjs && node generator/lint-authored.mjs && node generator/check-t3-pin.mjs && node test/static-routing/run.mjs && tsc --noEmit -p skills/poteto-mode/scripts/watch-pr/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json
scripts.test: env -u T3_MCP_URL node --test test/*.test.mjs test/*.test.ts skills/poteto-mode/scripts/*.test.ts skills/poteto-mode/scripts/watch-pr/*.test.ts && T3_MCP_URL=http://127.0.0.1:1/mcp node --test test/extension.test.ts test/roles.test.ts
